source_cautions.text: The ₹2,584.60 crore answer follows a question saying only 'this scheme', after an unrelated euthanasia item. The answer is preserved in the source evidence, but is not assigned to a scheme in the guide or tested.
The one-liner dates Surha Tal's 100th-site news to June 2026, while the map prints 19 January 2025. Keep both source dates visible; no current Ramsar-date verification is claimed.

The issue discusses a Modified UDAN launch on 4 July 2026 and Cabinet approval on 25 March 2026. These are kept as distinct milestones; the date is not silently replaced by one undifferentiated 'launch' date.

The international rankings table has visibly overlapping rows and awkward publisher/date entries. Its text is retained as source evidence; the guide uses only clearly readable HDR/GII rows and does not certify every rank or publisher as current.

The same page carries 7.7% provisional FY 2025-26 real GDP growth and 7.8% in a revised-estimates table under the new GDP series. Both are retained with their labels; no latest official estimate is asserted.

The prose says Sauj Lake and Sukhna were added on 15 October 2026, but the map labels Sauj 18 June 2026 and Sukhna 16 March 2026. The map also labels Surha Tal 19 January 2025 while p. 5 describes its 100th-site news in June 2026. These dates are preserved and not used as unqualified test keys.

The UP budget table's row labels and prose do not align cleanly: ₹1,77,744.12 crore appears next to 'Interest Payments' in the table, while prose describes about ₹1,77,744 crore as capital outlay. The evidence is retained; do not memorise that table row as an unqualified interest-payment figure.

MSME incentive details retain the source's 'July 2026 draft' label. Bihar budget totals retain their including/excluding debt-repayment and gross-appropriation definitions; they are not treated as interchangeable totals.
Some rows in the exercise table overlap in the PDF. The guide uses the clearly legible SIMBEX, VARUNA and SLINEX rows; consult the original page before learning other row-to-location matches.

The Messi item reports an international-retirement announcement on 31 August 2026 and a last match in October 2026. Both source statements are retained; the guide does not turn them into a single independently verified retirement date.

source_visual_scope: Focused page inspection of newly broadened national/news selections; not every PDF layout
limitations: A retained text block is not proof that an extracted table preserves its visual row/column relationships.
The 80 guided facts and quick notes are selective; all content-page text is in the full source evidence layer.
Current figures, appointments, results, rankings and legal developments are the supplied issue's claims and dates, not verified live updates.
No browser was available for visual HTML or end-to-end browser testing; static structure, links, script syntax and state-focused runtime checks are used.
